llm_response.reason: The website impersonates the North Sails brand despite no apparent official relationship, has ambiguous privacy and company information, lacks transparent contact or About pages, contains urgency-laced sales language, and restricts hyperlinks internally (cart, wishlist, home only). Official online shops feature comprehensive company/provenance information, clear payment/customer service pages, and transparent contact methods — all absent here. Brand mimicry and these features suggest strong scam indicators, consistent with Fake Online Shopping websites.
